brand.name: EC AIHR

hero.badge: Built for Thailand, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia factories
hero.headline: The HR system your workers already know how to use.
hero.subheadline: The only HR system your factory needs — built entirely on LINE. Clock-in, leave, payroll, and AI assistant inside the app your team opens every day.

why.title: Why LINE-First wins on the factory floor
why.subtitle: When 100% of your workforce already lives inside LINE, every other HR app is friction.

card1.title: Zero training, zero downloads
card1.desc: Workers tap the Rich Menu they already see every day. No new app, no new password, no PIN reset tickets.

card2.title: Designed for shift-floor reality
card2.desc: Geofence-aware clock-in, photo proof, IP whitelist, multi-shift rotation, and overtime that follows Thai labor law to the baht.

card3.title: AI Assistant built in
card3.desc: Workers and HR ask questions in LINE chat. The Mastra-powered agent answers from real data — leave balance, payslip, schedule, anything.

features.title: Every HR feature, inside LINE.
features.subtitle: What used to need three apps and a desktop now lives in one chat.

lineCheckin.title: LINE Clock-in
lineCheckin.desc: Geofence + GPS + IP + optional photo — all from one Rich Menu tap.

shifts.title: Shift Scheduling
shifts.desc: Drag-and-drop rotation patterns and AI-suggested coverage for 3-shift factories.

leave.title: Leave & OT Approvals
leave.desc: Workers request inside LINE, supervisors approve from a Flex Message — no app required.

payroll.title: Thai-Compliant Payroll
payroll.desc: OT 1.5x/2x/3x, SSO, withholding tax, severance — all calculated and exported.

compliance.title: Labor Law Built-in
compliance.desc: Minimum leave days, OT rates, holiday pay, and tax forms updated for Thai law.

ai.title: EC AIHR Assistant
ai.desc: Claude-powered agent reads live data: "Who is late today?", "Generate May payroll", "Suggest schedule for next week".

how.title: Three steps from purchase to running shift

step1.title: Connect your LINE OA
step1.desc: We bind your existing Employee and Management OAs in under 30 minutes. No new accounts.

step2.title: Import your roster
step2.desc: Upload your workers via CSV or sync from existing payroll. Each worker binds their LINE in one tap.

step3.title: Workers start using it tomorrow
step3.desc: Rich Menu goes live. Clock-in, leave, payroll — your team works the way they already chat.

compliance.title: Compliance and security, by design
compliance.subtitle: Thai Ministry of Labor + PDPA + SOC 2 controls.

items.title: Thai Labor Law
items.desc: Section 56 leave minimums, Section 61–63 OT rates (1.5x weekday, 3x holiday OT), Social Security Fund deductions.

items.title: PDPA-Ready
items.desc: Worker data residency in Singapore region, full audit trail, right-to-export and right-to-delete workflows.

items.title: Geofence + IP Protection
items.desc: Configurable factory radius (50–200m), VPN detection, photo verification, anti-spoofing.

items.title: Row-Level Security
items.desc: Postgres RLS policies enforce role-based access — supervisors see only their team, executives see read-only org rollups.

testimonials.title: From factory floors that already shipped to LINE-first

items.quote: The AI assistant alone is worth the subscription. I ask 'who's been late three times this month' and have an answer before I sit down.

analytics.title: Workforce Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Source-backed workforce, attendance, payroll, and operational reporting.
analytics.readOnlyDemoDescription: This view uses the explicitly configured demo organization. Connect a verified administrator identity before production use.
analytics.accessDeniedDescription: Only an organization owner, HR, executive, or supervisor can view workforce analytics. Supervisors only see their assigned team.
analytics.loadErrorDescription: Apply the analytics database migration and confirm the configured organization before opening this report again.
analytics.attendanceTrendDescription: Daily rates calculated from scheduled employee-days and first check-in records.
analytics.operatingPulseDescription: Key workforce costs and controls in the selected period.
analytics.departmentAttendanceDescription: Ranked attendance rate for departments in the current scope.
analytics.payrollTrendDescription: Gross and net payroll totals for the latest six recorded months.
analytics.departmentTableDescription: Headcount, time, payroll, and KPI measures on one comparable view.
analytics.leaveStatusDescription: Approved, pending, and rejected days by leave type.
analytics.riskDescription: Diagnostic prioritization based on absence, lateness, and high approved OT. It is not a predictive model.
analytics.dataQualityDescription: Records that need HR follow-up before decisions or payroll finalization.

qualityIssues.missing_line: Active employees not bound to LINE

analytics.methodologyAttendance: Attendance uses scheduled employee-days; approved leave is removed from expected attendance.
analytics.methodologyRisk: The watch score is a transparent diagnostic rule, not an AI prediction or an employment decision.
analytics.methodologyPayroll: Payroll values are recorded results. Review calculation status before using figures for filing or payment.
analytics.noData: No data recorded for this scope
